detail.longDescription: 🪶 NEW: A cherry-sized nodule found in # Montana ’s # HellCreek Formation held a 66-million-year-old feather, the best ever preserved from the age of # dinosaurs . Researchers concluded it came from an aquatic diving bird, likely eaten by a large # predator whose fossilized dung encased it along with # fish scales and bone fragments. The team says # feather insulation may have helped some # birds survive the # asteroid impact. 👉 https://www. npr.org/2026/09/10/nx-s1-59635 19/best-fossilized-bird-feather-dinosaur-feces-extinction # dinosaurs # fossils # paleontology # evolution # extinction # cretaceous # science # coprolite # research # naturalhistory # nature # history # biology
